TASK-001.title: Overdue list includes completed tasks and tasks due today
TASK-001.description: The overdue list should show unfinished work from before the supplied date. Users currently see work they finished and work that is not due until today.
acceptance_criteria: Include an unfinished task only when its due date is strictly before today.
Exclude completed tasks, even when their due date is in the past.
Exclude tasks due today or in the future.
Keep the input task list and task dictionaries unchanged.
Run the regression tests and report the observed result.

TASK-002.title: Show the oldest overdue task first
TASK-002.description: The overdue list needs a predictable order. TASK-001's tests check membership, but do not check order.
acceptance_criteria: Return overdue tasks in ascending due-date order, even when the input is unsorted.
Preserve input order for tasks with equal due dates.
Do not reorder or mutate the input list.
Add a regression test using overdue tasks supplied in the wrong order, and report its observed result.
